violations.recommendation: Add android:contentDescription with the action name, such as Back.
violations.agent_explanation: This ImageButton acts as a back button but has no text alternative.
violations.agent_why_it_matters: Screen reader users will only hear 'button, unlabelled' and won't know what it does.
violations.agent_developer_fix: In your XML layout, add android:contentDescription="@string/back_action" to the ImageButton.

violations.recommendation: Add android:hint or a programmatic label linked via labelFor.
violations.agent_explanation: The username field has no hint, text, or associated label.
violations.agent_why_it_matters: Users relying on assistive technology cannot tell what information to enter.
violations.agent_developer_fix: Add android:hint="Username" or a TextView label with android:labelFor pointing to this EditText.
